outrageously.songTitle: The Predatory Wasp of the Palisades Is Out to Get Us!
outrageously.line: Thinking outrageously I write in cursive
outrageously.lineNext: I hide in my bed with the lights on the floor
stanza: Thinking outrageously I write in cursive
I hide in my bed with the lights on the floor
Wearing three layers of coats and leg warmers
I see my own breath on the face of the door
